study: Breakout confirmation (not the first poke): after a charted resistance order block breaks upward, require a confirming close above the broken top plus a higher low (primary) before entering; compare to entering on the first poke.
registered_at: 2026-10-05 evening ET, before any breakout-confirmation outcome was computed on the sample
origin: Operator (Jonathan) via steering after S/R queue #2: Breakout confirmation (not the first poke) — require a close above resistance plus a higher low (or volume) before treating it as a run. Queued as #2b after size-by-room.
script: tools/studies/sr_breakout_confirm.py; blocks from tools/order_blocks.py (point-in-time, charted last 3 per side, swing 10, wicks, 1-min)
sample: admitted name-days of the 2026-10-02 indicator-levels study ($10+; control rows of ai_reports/indicator_levels/rows.json) with ext.pkl 1-min SIP bars (premarket+RTH). Same sessions as the sibling order-block studies. Break events on RTH 09:40-15:00 ET.
halves: chronological: first half of sample days vs second half
break_event: a charted bearish order block (among the last 3 per side known at that bar) becomes a breaker on bar i: max(open, close) > zone top (as tools/order_blocks.py). Decision known at the close of bar i. Only the first break of each block (origin_ts, top, btm) per name-day counts.
control_first_poke: buy at the open of bar i+1 (first poke after the break is known). Hold 15 min (15:55 cap). Gross = exit_close/entry − 1; net = gross − 0.20%.
signal_confirmed: after the break bar i, wait for the first later bar j (j > i, within 15 minutes, before 15:00) with close[j] > broken top AND low[j] > low[i] (higher low). Buy at the open of bar j+1. Same 15-min hold and cost. If no confirmation within 15 minutes, the event has no signal trade (dropped from the paired primary; counted).
pairing: primary uses break events that produce BOTH a poke entry and a confirmation entry (confirmation arrived in time). Lift = confirmed gross − poke gross on the same event.
pass: in BOTH chronological halves: mean(confirmed gross − poke gross) > measured RT spread of confirmed entries in that half (mean(gross−net) = 20 bp under the 0.20% model), AND >= 50 paired events per half. Also report net after costs for both legs. Fewer than 50 -> UNDERPOWERED. Any PASS = PENDING SKEPTIC REVIEW.
information_only: volume confirmation instead of higher low: close > top AND volume > 20-bar mean volume
unpaired: all poke trades vs all confirmed trades (different n)
prior: low-moderate. order_block_gate BREAKOUT / breakout-distance cells were information-only and not a registered pass. First-poke breakouts were among the worse cells on 10/02 level breaks.
caveats: flat 0.20% cost; measured RT = 20 bp under this model
SIP bars; live desk uses IEX
same mined sessions as sibling studies
confirmation delay means confirmed entries occur later — the test asks whether waiting helps, not whether breakouts beat random minutes
